criteria.sourceAccuracy: Each concept, numerical relation, and experimental condition was checked against the authoritative scanned spread; OCR was used only as a locator.
criteria.curriculumAlignment: Coverage was cross-checked with the current MEXT junior-high science curriculum commentary.
criteria.ibarakiExamReadiness: Every unit includes foundational recall plus experiment/data/graph/calculation reasoning consistent with the Ibaraki public exam analysis emphasis on using knowledge to solve problems.
criteria.calculationAudit: Density, concentration, solubility, spring, sound, frequency, and seismic-time calculations were recomputed with units.
criteria.distractorAudit: Choice distractors are same-domain misconceptions and do not duplicate the correct answer.
criteria.originality: Prompts, numerical datasets, diagrams, tables, and graphs are original and do not reproduce the textbook exercises or artwork.
criteria.contextCompleteness: All 192 prompts were checked for dangling references. Every question that depends on a graph, table, diagram, or named sample now displays that source material in the same question.
criteria.mobileAccessibility: All 33 figure uses have required alt text and captions and use safe data-driven rendering within a 390px viewBox.

limitations: This pack completes the scanned first-year science review; second- and third-year science remain separate work.
Mastery of this pack strengthens entrance-exam readiness but cannot by itself guarantee admission; timed mixed-year past-paper practice is still required.
